# Golden encodings of moonpool-rpc references (protobuf, protocol version 1).
#
# Independent of Rust: each line is `name hex`, and the bytes follow the
# field tables in the `ServiceRef` / `InterfaceRef` docs (tag order, fields
# equal to their default left out, as proto3 and prost do). A change to any
# line is a wire break.
#

#   admission), token index 1<<63 | 42 (well-known id 42), generation 0
